capabilities: extract the source name from a copied citation
paste clipboard quotes as formatted callouts
preserve bold, italic, and hyperlink formatting in quotes
trigger conversion via command palette, ribbon icon, or hotkey
extras: Requires Obsidian v0.15.0 or higher; works best when the copied content already has proper citation formatting.
problem: Pasting quoted material leaves citations as plain text; Obsidian has no built-in way to turn them into formatted callouts with source titles.
summary: Paste plugin that converts a clipboard quote with a citation into a callout titled with the extracted source name.
